technicalNoteSection.title: The Science of Local Processing
technicalNoteSection.description: Most PDF tools use a 'Server-Side' architecture: your file is uploaded to a cloud server, processed, and then sent back. MyToolTrove utilizes WebAssembly (WASM) and client-side JavaScript to move the entire processing engine into your browser. This means the merging logic executes on your local CPU, ensuring that not a single byte of your personal data ever leaves your machine. It's not just faster—it's fundamentally more secure.
